$comment: Generator metadata. Values that CSS already holds are NOT repeated
here — scripts/generate.mjs parses css/tokens.css for those. This file
holds only what a stylesheet cannot express.
`version` is the one number that matters operationally: it is copied
into brand.lock, which is vendored byte-identical into every consumer,
so 'which sites are on which brand version' is answerable by grep.
The composition has an internal short-name as of 2026-09-20: B-Wordmark
for the mark-in-word, B-Slogan for the sentence. Internal only — the
® rides on HeartBank and neither short-name carries a mark of its own.
There is NO wordmark asset and there must not be one. The moment this
ships as an SVG a consumer takes the SVG, and the colour stops
inheriting — the same defect causes for the mark itself.
It is a COMPOSITION of files a consumer already holds: emblem.ts for
the glyph, tokens.css for --emblem, motion.css for .beating, and the
site's own i18n for the words. brand.333.eco/wordmark/ renders it.
wordmark.division: Bank = what accumulates is the RECORD of appreciation. Heart = what circulates is the VALUE.
wordmark.substitution: Wherever possible the B in 'Bank' is replaced by the B-Emblem — 'Thank with Heart3ank®'. Only the B in Bank, never the T in Thank.
wordmark.plainText: Heart3ank®. The stand-in is a 3, NOT a heart character: the mark is bistable as a heart AND a capital B, and ♥ keeps only the half that does not carry the letter. (It is also why the estate's shorthand for HeartBank® is H3.) A literal B remains correct where a 3 would read as a digit — a legal instrument, a form field, anything parsed by machine.
wordmark.registrationSymbol: Drawn at full cap height by every typeface: correct at body size, too heavy at display size, where it competes with the mark it defers to. Scale it optically in display settings only; a call site at ~1rem needs no special treatment.

mark.name: B-Emblem™
mark.shape: A universal heart rotated 45° clockwise. Bistable — heart AND capital B, both immediately apparent. Not a reveal.
rules: Inline in the DOM. Never — CSS cannot reach inside an .
The 45° rotation is baked into the path coordinates. Never a transform attribute.
`.beating` goes on CHROME and never beside a person's name.

geometry.$comment: MEASURED with getBBox() on 2026-09-20, not assumed. Every call site in the estate had silently inherited the consequence.
geometry.detail: The path's bounding box is 18.0828 x 18.0851 inside the 24 x 24 viewBox, so the mark paints across 75.34% of its own square and leaves ~12.3% margin on every side. An <svg> sized 1em therefore paints a 0.753em mark, and the heartbeat's 1.3 peak lands at 0.979em — the box almost exactly. That is why the beat READ AS GROWING TO FIT its slot rather than growing beyond it, and why the rest state looked like the shrunken one.
geometry.fix: Size the BOX by the reciprocal (--emblem-size / 0.7534) so the painted mark is --emblem-size at rest, then pull the inline footprint back to --emblem-size with negative inline margins. The letters keep their spacing, the mark fills what it occupies, and the beat overflows it by the full 30%.
geometry.neverTransform: ⛔ Do it with the BOX, never with transform: scale(). A CSS animation on `transform` overrides a non-animated one, so `.beating` would silently eat the correction — the same trap the 45-degree rotation is baked into the path coordinates to avoid.
geometry.opticalSize: ⭐ Separate from the fix and a pure design choice, because 'fills its footprint' holds at any size. Compare against the CAP HEIGHT of the letters beside it, never the em box, which includes ascender and descender room no capital uses. brand.333.eco ships 0.85em = 118% of cap height; 1em reads as 138% and swamps the letters.

states.static: Proof of Coordinate ℠ — a meaningful state, not a degradation.
states.beating: Proof of Humanity ℠ — but only where the beat can be verified. Ambient institutional beating claims 'humans run this', not 'this person is human'.

mettaLight.$comment: The session descent. css/metta.css is OPT-IN and is not vendored by a surface with no session.
mettaLight.api: The app sets --t (0 at session start, 1 at session end) on an element carrying the .metta class. Everything downstream reads --metta.
mettaLight.stops: The B-Gem order, ruby to diamond. Seven stops, six segments; stop i sits at t = i/6.
mettaLight.notAnimated: --metta is COMPUTED, never animated. An @property-registered custom property interpolated by @keyframes is the obvious build and is broken in the configuration this feature requires: Chrome does not reliably re-rasterise an element for an animated custom property it INHERITS, and the failure is invisible to getComputedStyle. Six color-mix() steps weighted by clamp() windows instead — no registration, no keyframes, no ticker.
mettaLight.classScoped: The chain is declared on .metta and NOT on :root. Custom properties inherit their computed value, so a chain on :root resolves once against root's --t and descendants inherit a frozen colour. The element that sets --t must carry the chain.
mettaLight.guards: No numerals, no totals, no streaks, no ranks. The light carries the whole signal; --t is an input, never a readout.
mettaLight.breathNotHeartbeat: The lamp's swell is a symmetrical breath with no claim attached. The heartbeat is a Proof-of-Humanity signal with a placement rule. Never give the lamp .beating, and never give a mark the breath. Under reduced motion the breath stops and the COLOUR DOES NOT — freezing the descent would misreport where the sitter is.
mettaLight.nativePorting: Same seven stops, same single scalar: interpolate the gem list at t. That is why it belongs in platform-native animation rather than a library.

motion.signature: Cardiac morphology: two UNEQUAL beats then a long rest — systole, a weaker diastole, then most of the period at rest.
motion.notRate: The RHYTHM is the signature, NOT the cadence or the amplitude. ~40 BPM at 1.5s ships; a 72 BPM variant was built and rejected. A published spec once claimed ~72 BPM / ~8% expansion — that claim was reframed, not the code.
motion.rest: The diastolic rest is IN THE KEYFRAMES (70%->100%, 450ms of every 1500ms), recurring on every cycle. It is not --beat-delay, which is a CSS animation-delay and fires once before the first iteration only. Both produce stillness; only the keyframe rest is part of the rhythm.
motion.startDelay: --beat-delay is 0s as of v1.3.0. It was 1.5s, which bought nothing recurring and left a Proof-of-Humanity signal motionless for a beat and a half after paint. The token is kept for per-instance STAGGER, so several marks on one screen need not beat in lockstep.
motion.reducedMotion: Stop, and substitute nothing. The static mark is already a meaningful state.

accentRule.rule: A site's accent is DERIVED, never picked: it takes the gem whose media type IS that product's medium.
cannotDerive: --accent-ink — Fire Opal on white is 3.4:1 and fails; Sapphire on white is 7.0:1 and passes. No formula picks correctly.
--accent-soft on a light ground — the generic oklab mix does not always clear 4.5:1. Measure and pin.
accentRule.honestCount: The goal was 'a fifth site is five declarations'. It is nine.

sites.because: the product IS a voice recording
the medium is MOTION — a name called, an object crossing a circle
a registry resolves a name to an ADDRESS
the commons' medium is not one of the seven — a SITE value, not an eighth gem

constants.mono: IBM Plex Mono — one mono across the estate is a system, two is a coincidence.
constants.khmer: Noto Sans Khmer — present on every site in the tree.

fonts.perSite: The display face is the only genuine per-site variable. A site that picks an expanded face owns the type-scale consequence.
